content.key_idea: Kareus identifies repeating attention-AllReduce and MLP-AllReduce partitions in a pipeline-parallel training iteration, and for each partition type finds a time-energy Pareto frontier of overlapping computation/communication schedules via multi-objective Bayesian optimization.
content.reading_order: Top to bottom: the full training iteration's 1F1B pipeline schedule, zooming into one Transformer block's partitioned overlap execution across two nanobatches, then into a single partition's detailed kernel execution schedule, and finally the time-energy Pareto frontiers each schedule is chosen from.

summary: This figure gives Kareus's execution and optimization overview across four stacked rows. The top row shows one training iteration under the 1F1B pipeline schedule, with forward (F) and backward (B) microbatches per stage. The second row zooms into a Transformer block's partitioned overlap execution across two nanobatches, showing repeating orange Attention-AllReduce and blue MLP-AllReduce partitions - kernels with no data dependency that can overlap. The third row expands one partition into its detailed kernel execution schedule (Norm, Linear 1, RoPE, FlashAttention, Linear 2 computation kernels overlapped with an AllReduce communication kernel), annotated with the SM allocation, frequency, and launch-timing knobs Kareus tunes. The bottom row shows the time-energy Pareto frontier that Kareus's multi-objective Bayesian optimizer computes for each partition type, with the schedule from row three marked as one point on the Attn-AR frontier. Curved arrows and consistent orange/blue coloring tie the four zoom levels together.
